instruction: Remove red eye from the portrait on my desktop using the red eye removal tool.

metadata.explanation: GIMP red eye correction task. Requires using the red eye removal tool on a portrait. Marked as infeasible because detecting red eye pixels and verifying their correction requires computer vision analysis of specific image regions and color values in portrait photos.

llm_judge_reasons: Correctly marked as infeasible - red eye removal verification requires computer vision analysis

Red eye detection and correction verification would require: (1) face/eye detection algorithms, (2) color analysis of specific eye regions to identify red/orange pixels, (3) before/after comparison of those pixel clusters
Available GIMP metrics (structure_sim, brightness, contrast, saturation, image size, mirroring, palette, layer existence) cannot detect or verify red eye correction
This is a specialized computer vision task beyond simple pixel comparison or image property checking
The 'infeasible' classification is semantically correct for this verification requirement
